description: Web ACL with a Rule Group Overridden to Count
rationale: A Count override applies to every rule of the referenced group at once, so a managed rule group that would refuse SQL injection, path traversal and the payloads of known exploits is reduced to counting them. The override exists to let a new rule group run against production traffic before it is trusted, and it is meant to be removed once the false positives are understood; left in place it silences the whole group while the web ACL still lists it among its rules.
remediation: Remove the Count override from the rule group, keeping targeted rule action overrides for the individual rules that genuinely misfire
